guidance.claim: Full year revenue growth guidance revised to 1.5% to 3% in constant currency.
guidance.quote: With our Q1 results and a view of the rest of the financial year, we have changed our revenue growth guidance to 1.5% to 3% Y-on-Y growth in constant currency terms.
guidance.speaker: Company Secretary

guidance.claim: Operating margin guidance remains unchanged at 20% to 22%.
guidance.quote: Our operating margin guidance remains the same at 20% to 22%.
guidance.speaker: Company Secretary

guidance.claim: Effective tax rate for the year is expected between 29% and 30%.
guidance.quote: We expect effective tax rate for the year to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
guidance.speaker: Company Secretary

guidance.claim: Onsite mix excluding new acquisitions is expected to reduce by 75 bps to 1%.
guidance.quote: We expect Onsite mix excluding new acquisitions to reduce by 75 bps to 1% for the year.
guidance.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: Q1 revenue growth was 2.4% year-on-year and 1% sequentially in constant currency.
reported.quote: Our revenue growth for Q1 was at 2.4% Y-on-Y and 1% Q-on-Q in constant currency terms.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: AI services revenue accounted for 8.2% of overall revenue in Q1.
reported.quote: Our AI services revenue was 8.2% of overall revenue in Q1.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: Large deal wins were $3.6 billion with 61% net new.
reported.quote: Our large deals, $3.6 bn at 61% net new, operating margin at 21.1%, free cash flow at $955 mn.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: Operating margin for the quarter was reported at 21.1%.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: Free cash flow for the quarter was $955 million.
reported.quote: Free cash flow was strong at $955 mn at 116.5% of net profit.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: Earnings per share grew 15% year-on-year in rupee terms.
reported.quote: Earnings per share were up 15% Y-on-Y in rupee terms.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary
